title: WorkItem
description: One unit of fix work: an advisory whose exposures must close, or a finding that must be fixed, with the related items that the same fix covers.

advisory.description: For the kind `exposure`: the advisory to fix.

finding.description: For the kind `finding`: the finding to fix.

relatedAdvisories.description: Other advisories of the same family on the same component, which the same fix closes.

component.description: Limits the work to one component, by name.

application.description: Limits the work, and its one candidate, to one application.

graft.description: For a Nix component: fix it with a graft of the patched library into the existing closures, not with an overlay that rebuilds the dependents.
